chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام was asked about a judge between two villages who takes a provision from the ruler for judging. He said: “That is suht.”

key_terms.ٱلرِّزْقَ: provision or salary taken in return for service
key_terms.ٱلسُّلْطَانِ: the ruling authority or political ruler
key_terms.ٱلْقَضَاءِ: the act of judging or judicial office

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a judge to take a salary from the ruler for judging between people?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a judge who receives compensation from the ruler for carrying out judicial duties. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام declares such income to be suht, indicating its unlawfulness and underscoring the gravity of corruption or illegitimate gain in judicial office.
